training: No retraining; retain both E15 model tables as independent components
algorithm: Conditional arithmetic probability mixture (1-alpha)*P_daily + alpha*P_balanced; log-sum-exp before existing +6/clipping/OOV/weight/normalization. Shared union vocabulary: split each component UNK among missing union glyphs and residual UNK using the other component unigram proportions. Never assign the whole UNK mass to each new glyph.

development.gate: Each domain: top1/top5/recall255 nondecreasing and total top1 character errors nonincreasing; new domain top1 strictly increases
development.selection: Eligible models only: highest sum of top1 over both equal-sized domains, then least combined errors, then highest combined top5, then smaller alpha. Retain all individual losses. If none pass, keep baseline and do not open test candidates.

test.oldDomain: p2c-daily-mixture-v8/test.tsv (new Tatoeba families, excluding all previous proposals)
test.gate: Each domain: top1/top5/recall255 nondecreasing and total top1 character errors nonincreasing; new domain top1 strictly increases. Repeated complete output must agree. No retuning after opening.
test.opening: One selected alpha only after model/configuration/development report hashes are frozen. Include baseline.

deployment: Offline pass is necessary but insufficient; Android model memory/loading, repeated typing latency, personal words, privacy, editor lifecycle, short words and partial pinyin require acceptance before wiring production factory. No automatic APK asset replacement.
